chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 18: Xiao Chen's Preemptive Strike
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen recovers from injury and discovers Zhao Lin'er has allied with a foreign noble. He decides to strike first, coldly assassinating three enemies before reinforcements arrive.
og_description: Xiao Chen gains a rare dragon crystal and strikes preemptively against Zhao Lin'er's new ally. A tense chapter of stealth and cold calculation.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen doesn't wait for his enemies to gather strength. In a chapter of silent kills, he thins the numbers before the real battle begins.
